rule: Light arrives at once along a dead straight line and stops on the first opaque thing; whatever it touches is Lit (shown through any cover, front armour counts half), and a light hit on a target that is already Lit Sears it: +25%, and the Lit starts again.

new_mechanics.name: sear
new_mechanics.definition: Affinity key 'sear_vs_lit' (Light 0.25): a hit tagged light on a target that was Lit before the hit does that much more and refreshes Lit. Reveal first, smite second. Lit and the opaque rule are already built (2026-10-22 drafts) and are not redefined.

skills.name: Dayline
skills.summary: An instant line of daylight, 16 m: the first thing on it takes 60 and is Lit for 6 s. Walls, stone and a raised shield stop it.
skills.verb_fit: Shine is to illuminate: Lit is what Shine means in a fight. The ranged caster's starter: the reveal, and on a second line the Sear.

good_modifiers.word: A line that blinds as it lights: the long-range answer to a Rampart Archer, which loses its aim.
A sharper, farther line: 18 m and harder, for picking the back rank.
A line that stuns as it lights: the target is Dazed and takes 50% more from your follow-up.
22 m of light for a little less damage: the whole room is in reach.
The line glances on to one more body after the first.

bad_modifiers.why: Light that bends breaks the affinity's rule; on an instant line it only nudges reach and damage by 5-10%.
A ray of light that hauls its target 1.5 m toward you has no meaning; the fallback is a free pull that belongs to water.
Light does not lift bodies; the fallback is a free Aloft on a cheap bolt, a second skill hidden in a modifier.

skills.name: Dusk Well
skills.summary: Point, 10 m: a pool of dusk 4 m across for 7 s. Nothing outside can see or shoot into it, and nothing inside can see out - but Lit enemies stay in plain view, and against the dusk they stand out: your light does 20% more to a Lit enemy inside it.
skills.verb_fit: Dim is to dull the light. The ranged caster's cover from archers: the light is turned down over one patch, except on what you have already lit.

new_mechanics.name: lit_bonus (zone)
new_mechanics.definition: A zone with lit_bonus: the caster's light hits on a Lit enemy standing in it do that much more (on top of the Sear).

good_modifiers.word: A long dusk: 10.5 s of cover to stand in.
A wide dusk, 5.2 m across, big enough to hide a whole fight from the archers.
A dusk that drinks the light: Lit ones in it stand out even more, for less reflux.
Dropped 14 m away, over the archers' nest instead of over you: they cannot see out.

bad_modifiers.why: Lighting the dark undoes it: Lit bodies show through the well, so the fallback (Lit on everyone in it) cancels the skill's only effect.
The well has no hit to carry Blinded, and a glare inside a dusk contradicts it; the fallback does nothing.
A patch of dark has no force; there is no hit to carry a shove, so the fallback does nothing.

skills.change_note: adds lit_bonus 0.2 (Lit enemies stand out against the dusk) so it has a power number and serves reveal-then-smite; Bend modifier replaced (Bend is re-meant).

skills.name: Glint
skills.summary: You are a streak of light: up to 7 m along your aim in an instant, through enemies, searing each one you pass for 20 and lighting it. A wall, stone or a raised shield stops you short.
skills.verb_fit: Flash is a sudden burst of light. Glint is you becoming that burst: there is no travel time at all, only before and after, and the flash leaves its mark on everything it passed.

good_modifiers.word: A 9 m streak: across a room in no time.
Out of the streak and casting a quarter sooner.
A streak that blinds the line it crosses: run through the archers and they lose you.
A 9.8 m streak; the longest instant move there is.

bad_modifiers.why: Holding a streak in place contradicts it; it has no speed to lower and no lasting effect but Lit, so the fallback just stretches Lit.
Light that has to be charged is not a flash; the streak has no power to raise, so the fallback only slows the cast.
A delayed instant is a contradiction; there is no damage to build, so the fallback only adds wind-up.

skills.change_note: +20 damage to each body passed, so the movement starter is shaped by the caster's role and has a power number.

skills.name: Still Lamp
skills.summary: Point, 9 m: hang a steady lamp for 12 s. Every enemy within 5 m of it is Lit while it stays: it cannot hide and its armour's gaps show, and your Sears on anyone in its light are 10% heavier. One lamp at a time; it blocks nothing.
skills.verb_fit: Glow is a steady soft light. The lamp is that light given a place: it does no harm, it just keeps everything near it lit, for as long as it lasts.

new_mechanics.name: sear_bonus (lamp)
new_mechanics.definition: A lamp prop with sear_bonus adds that much to the Sear (sear_vs_lit) on light hits against enemies within its light_radius.

good_modifiers.word: An 18 s lamp: light a doorway for the whole wall.
A brighter lamp, lighting 6.5 m around.
A lamp that throws its light 30% farther, for a little more essence.
Hung 12.6 m away, behind the shield line.

bad_modifiers.why: A still lamp that moves is a different skill; the lamp has no speed, so the fallback does nothing.
A lamp that shoves everything near it every half second makes no sense; the fallback is a free knockback zone.
A short lamp loses the steadiness that is its whole point; it has no damage for the +25% to raise.

skills.change_note: +10% to Sears in its light (sear_bonus), so the reveal tool also feeds the smite.

skills.name: Noonburst
skills.summary: Light and heat pour out of you: everything within 3.5 m with a clear line to you takes a heavy hit and is Lit. A raised shield shades whoever holds it.
skills.verb_fit: Radiate is to send light and heat outward. The burst goes out from you in every direction at once, and like all light it only reaches what it can see: walls, stone and shields cast shadows it does not cross.

good_modifiers.word: A wider noon: 4.5 m, a little weaker.
A blinding noon: the whole ring is Dazed and takes 50% more from what follows.
Everything around you is Blinded: the melee ring loses track of you.
A tighter, hotter burst: 2.8 m and 30% harder.

bad_modifiers.why: A burst in every direction has no single path to bounce; the fallback hands one random enemy a stray extra hit.
There is no projectile to pierce; Pierce on a burst does nothing.
A ring is not a line; the burst has no speed, and 10% reach is all that is left of the word.

skills.name: Gathered Light
skills.summary: Every Lit enemy within 12 m that has a clear line to you gives its light back: it takes 60 and loses Lit, and the ray coming home hits everything between it and you for 40.
skills.verb_fit: Absorb is to draw light and heat in. Every light you set comes home along a straight line: the smite that cashes in the reveal.

good_modifiers.word: Call the light home from 16.8 m.
Sharper light, called from farther and hitting 10% harder.
Fewer, brighter returns: 9.6 m reach, 30% harder.
The heat comes home with the light: 15% less reflux.

bad_modifiers.why: Lighting the bodies you are emptying of light contradicts the word: the fallback re-applies the Lit it just took.
Pushing targets away from a skill that draws in makes no sense; the fallback shoves every target 1.5 m out of the lines.
Its own opposite: sending light out on a skill that draws it in. The fallback only stretches range for more essence.

skills.name: Hard Glare
skills.summary: A cone of hard light, 8 m long: everything in it takes 20 and is Blinded for 3 s. Archers lose their aim; others only swing at what is right in front of them.
skills.verb_fit: Glare is a blinding glare. The skill barely hurts; what it does is take away sight, which is exactly what a glare does.

good_modifiers.word: Blinded for 4.5 s: a long window to close on the back line.
An 11 m cone, reaching archers who stand at their full range.
A glare that also Dazes: the blinded take 50% more while they stumble.
A wider cone that catches the whole shield line.

bad_modifiers.why: Its own opposite: restoring sight on a skill that takes it away; the fallback only adds 10% to a 20-damage hit.
A dimmed glare is a contradiction; the fallback just weakens it.
A cone has no projectile to pierce; the fallback does nothing.

skills.name: Clear Eye
skills.summary: For 6 s you see every gap: each enemy within 15 m is Lit at once, and your hits on Lit enemies ignore front armour completely.
skills.verb_fit: Clarity restores and sharpens sight. The skill sharpens yours: it shows you everything nearby and every gap in every guard.

good_modifiers.word: 9 s of clear sight: a whole Pavise pair's worth.
It stays with you 30% longer.
Everything within 21 m is Lit on the cast.
A cheaper look: 15% less essence.

bad_modifiers.why: Blinding is the opposite of clear sight, and a self-buff has no hit to carry Blinded; the fallback does nothing.
No hit to carry a shove; the fallback does nothing.
A buff on you has no targets to jump between; the fallback only costs 15% power the buff does not have.

skills.name: Glancing Ray
skills.summary: A ray that glances off walls, stone and raised shields up to twice, 14 m in all, hitting the first body on each leg for 55 and lighting it. Bank it off a wall to reach the back of a shield line.
skills.verb_fit: Reflect turns light back. The ray is ordinary light whose whole point is the turn: it is how a light fighter, who can only shoot straight, gets round a corner or a shield.

good_modifiers.word: A 19.6 m path: room for a long bank shot.
A sharper ray that reaches farther and hits harder.
A third leg, for a little less on each hit.
Every body the ray finds is Blinded too.

bad_modifiers.why: A bent ray stops being a reflection: the bank shot depends on straight legs. The fallback only nudges reach and damage.
Absorbing light on a skill that throws it back is contradictory; the fallback is a bonus against Lit targets that the ray lights itself.
A shorter path ruins the bank shot (11.9 m); +20% damage does not make up for missing the target.

skills.name: Burning Glass
skills.summary: Bend the light through a lens onto one spot up to 14 m away: a bright point for 0.8 s, then it burns through - 130 to everything within 1.2 m, and 40 poise. Put it on a Lit enemy and the point follows it; anyone it burns that was Lit is Seared. Needs a clear line from you.
skills.verb_fit: Bend, re-meant: 'bend light through a lens to a burning point'. Nothing flies from you; the light is bent onto the spot, and the bending is the wind-up you see.

new_mechanics.name: follows_lit
new_mechanics.definition: A delayed_blast cast on an enemy that is Lit tracks it: the blast lands where that enemy is when the delay ends. On anything else it lands on the spot, as delayed_blast does now.

good_modifiers.word: Clear Glass: a sharper point, from farther, a little harder
A finer point: 30% harder on a smaller spot
Burns through sooner: harder to walk out of
A glass that drinks the light: hotter on the Lit, and cooler on you

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: turning back the light you are gathering. A blast has no line to bounce; the extra jump falls back to a little power
a lens that scatters is no lens: wider and weaker, the opposite of the skill
nothing travels; no speed field. Falls back

skills.name: Sunlance
skills.summary: Hold to draw the light into one line (up to 1.4 s, walking at 40%), then let it go: a lance of light 18 m long through every body on it, 90 to 280 by the charge, 50 poise, and Lit. Walls, stone and raised shields still stop it. Dear: the caster's big smite.
skills.verb_fit: Ray is 'all the light in one line'. The one light that passes through bodies, because all of it is in the line.

good_modifiers.word: Long Lance: held longer, it burns harder
A sharper lance: farther and harder
A blinding lance: everything on the line is Blinded
A lance that crosses the room: 25 m

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: splitting the line you have gathered. The jumps spread a one-line skill thin; maths lets it act, it should not
spreads what the lance concentrates: wider and weaker
let go at once on a skill that is all charge: the weakest lance, sooner. Falls back to a little power

skills.name: Prism Bolt
skills.summary: A shard of light: 50 to the first enemy it hits, and there it breaks into four rays fanned 60 degrees on through it, 7 m each, 30 and Lit to the first body each finds. Into a crowd it lights the whole pack for the Sears that follow.
skills.verb_fit: Prism is 'split the light into many rays'. The shard exists to break.

new_mechanics.name: split
new_mechanics.definition: A projectile with 'split' ends on its first hit and casts split.count instant light lines from that point, fanned over split.arc_deg around its flight, each split.range long, each hitting the first body it meets with split.damage and split.on_hit, and stopping on walls, stone and raised shields as all light does.

good_modifiers.word: A fifth ray, a little lighter each
Sharper rays: longer and harder
Each ray glances on to one more body
A wider fan for a wider pack

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: concentrating the light it splits. Pierce sends the shard through its first body instead of breaking on it; maths lets it act, it undoes the skill
a tighter, harder hit with shorter rays: the opposite of a spread
the same as Ray: it passes the body it should break on

skills.name: Bent Light
skills.dropped_why: Going unseen is Dark's now (the assassin), and false images are Dream's (the enchanter); Light is the ranged caster that reveals. Bend is re-meant to gathering light through a lens (Burning Glass).
